We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied template 29646 to target molecule, got three possible precursors (tuples). The result is a tuple of three strings? Actually apply_template returns list of precursor SMILES strings. The result shows three tuples each containing a string. So possible precursors: 
1) "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"
2) "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"
3) "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"

We need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389. Likely the template 1914389 expects a certain functional group pattern: It seems to involve a phosphate group? The retro smarts: '[C:8]/[CH;D2;+0:7]=[CH;D2;+0:1]/[C:2]=[C:3]/[C:4](=[O;D1;H0:5])-[OH;D1;+0:6]>>C-C-O-P(=O)(-O-C-C)-[CH2;D2;+0:1]/[C:2]=[C:3]/[C:4](=[O;D1;H0:5])-[O;H0;D2;+0:6]-C-C.O=[CH;D2;+0:7]-[C:8]'

So forward reaction forms a phosphate ester? The retro template (used in retrosynthesis) would break a phosphate group to give a carbon chain with a double bond etc. Our precursor from 29646 includes a silyl group [Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C attached to O. That may be a protecting group for alcohol. The next template likely removes silyl protecting group? Actually 1914389 seems to involve a phosphate group, not silyl. Maybe we need to apply 1914389 to the product of 29646? But the order is given: we must use templates in that order for the route. So first step: apply 29646 to target, giving precursors. Then apply 1914389 to each of those precursors? Actually retrosynthesis: we go from target to precursors stepwise. So after first step, we have intermediate(s). Then apply second template to each intermediate to get earlier precursors, etc.

Thus we need to construct a tree with 5 reaction levels, each using the specified template IDs.

We need to produce JSON route: root molecule is target SMILES. Child reaction node with template_id 29646, children are precursor molecules (SMILES). Then for each precursor, we need to apply next template 1914389, etc. Could be linear chain (single precursor each step) to keep simple. Choose one precursor that matches next template. We need to check if template 1914389 matches that precursor. Use check_smiles_reaction_template_matching.
